passage:
A science fair displayed a 3D-printed hand made for a child who had lost fingers. It was lighter and cheaper than many traditional devices.
Students were amazed that plastic pieces and strings could help someone hold objects.
The engineer explained that 3D printing allowed designs to be changed quickly as the child grew. However, it still required careful testing and fitting.
The hand was not a toy, though it looked simple. It was a tool shaped around one person's needs.
The exhibit showed that invention is not only about creating something new. It is about understanding someone's problem closely enough to make a solution fit.
